review_candidates.description: Job Requisition ID # 26WD102244 Position Overview Autodesk is looking for a Principal Network Engineer to join the Global Network Engineering team. Come join us in our journey to provide our customers with a world-class SaaS platform, enabling imaginative and industry-changing Autodesk products. We are looking for passionate network engineers who are fascinated by the technologies behind the internet, data centers, and cloud computing. The team is crucial to the design and deployment of a consistent, stable infrastructure that meets both network engineering design standards and product goals. As a member of the Network Engineering team, you will maintain advanced networking and security technologies across SD-WAN, SASE, wireless, data center, and cloud environments. You will troubleshoot, implement, and improve standards, implementations, and procedures related to all cloud and data center networking technologies, including but not limited to LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, switches, routers, wireless, load balancers, and firewalls. You will participate in cross-team and organizational projects, designing, documenting, and implementing new and secure networking solutions. Responsibilities Own the lifecycle of the global network, from design, qualification, and deployment through operation and optimization Lead the implementation of Autodesk's global networking backbone and strategic infrastructure initiatives Design, deploy, and operate the SD-WAN fabric connecting offices, data centers, and cloud environments, including path selection, QoS, and application-aware policy Architect and manage the enterprise SASE solution, including Palo Alto Prisma Access (ZTNA, secure web gateway, and cloud-delivered firewall policy) Design and operate BGP routing and peering across data center, WAN, internet edge, and cloud connectivity, including route policy, traffic engineering, and peering relationships Design and support enterprise wireless networks, including controller and cloud-managed deployments, site surveys, capacity planning, and security Create and update network standards, reference architectures, and design patterns, and ensure the network is deployed to those standards Work closely with automation teams to define the tools that let us scale at outstanding volume, and automate networking tasks and self-service tools Design, secure, and operate network connectivity to AWS and Azure, including Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, and hybrid connectivity Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex, high-impact network incidents, and drive monitoring and observability improvements Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, SRE, and IT teams to deliver secure, resilient networking solutions Participate in organizational objective planning sessions and contribute to the network roadmap Manage relationships with third-party vendors and carriers, including evaluations, contracts, and escalations Mentor and cross-train teammates, and provide technical leadership across multiple teams Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience 7+ years of experience in enterprise routing and switching, including design and operation of large-scale networks Hands-on experience designing and operating SD-WAN solutions in an enterprise environment Experience with SASE and zero trust network access, ideally Palo Alto Prisma Access, including policy design, connectivity, and troubleshooting Deep expertise in BGP routing and peering relationship management, plus working knowledge of OSPF and MPLS Solid understanding of enterprise wireless networking, including RF design, 802.11 standards, authentication (802.1X), and troubleshooting Good level of proficiency and experience with TCP/IP networking, architecture, and core technologies, such as DNS, DHCP, IPsec, VPN, and VLAN/switching Knowledge of firewalls, security configurations, and troubleshooting, with Palo Alto Networks experience a plus Knowledge of dark fiber and the technologies surrounding it Knowledge of AWS and Azure networking design and services Able to design, secure, and automate AWS networking infrastructure Demonstrated history of AWS experience with Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, VPC, and related services Infrastructure automation proficiency (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) Python, Ansible, and DevOps methodology knowledge Proven ability to work effectively within an Agile framework Skilled at presenting technical policies, proposals, and designs Clear communicator with a positive attitude Ability to manage long-term, project/milestone-based work with multiple teams Preferred Qualifications Experience with Juniper wireless, such as Juniper Mist AI Experience with Juniper switching and routing platforms Experience with network monitoring and observability tools Experience with network access control, such as Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass Palo Alto Networks certification (such as PCNSE) AWS Solutions Architect Associate Cisco CCNA Cisco CCNP Juniper certification (such as JNCIA or JNCIS)
